source_note: DEMO. Client demo workspace on its own demo WhatsApp number (lead.isDemo=false but the workspace is a demo build, never live). Customer side = a 41 Labs team member testing the demo (internal tester, not a real shopper). The three product messages were each sent with a product photo (not included here). Payment link was a sandbox/DEMO link (no charge). No trimming: these are the first 12 messages of the chat; later messages (15+ days later) are excluded. Redactions: tester name -> placeholder, business name -> [Business], SKU codes and internal branch codes masked, payment URL -> [secure payment link].
